github_surges.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) ecosystem: curated plugins, tools, and infrastructure from dsh-external/hub and the public dsh-plugin topic.
Bot Mode for the Hermes desktop: a roster of named agents with their own chats, avatars, routines, and bot-to-bot messaging. Desktop plugin, no core patches.
Best browser for AI agents, built in Rust.

让纯文本模型更好地做视觉任务的DeepSeek Harness插件：带意图的图片问答、长截图 OCR、UI 还原等｜DeepSeek Harness-native integration for agent-vision-toolkit: image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI restoration, grounding, pixel diff, Artifacts, and Web UI.
Context-aware CrewMind platform featuring machine-learning-integration technology and advanced geospatial-analytics for modern director
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 从 0 到 1 深度手册：安装/插件开发/性能调优/实测案例/同模型多 Agent 实测对比（中文 + 英文 PDF）
V4 Flash 神模式 (opencode-go)：让 opencode-go 的 DeepSeek V4 Flash 从鬼模式切换到神模式的 dsh agent preset

Anti-laziness skill for AI agents. Core: the Depth Tree method, which splits a task N layers deep and gives every leaf the full time budget of the whole task, so effort multiplies with depth. Grounded in 2025-2026 research on model laziness, underthinking and premature completion.
Open-source Grok Bot alternative. Choose your own model and sandbox.

Reference architecture for AI agents that propose actions but cannot authorize them — immutable intent capture, an independent Decionis policy verdict (ALLOW/ESCALATE/BLOCK), verified human approval, and a SafeExecutor that consumes a single-use intent-bound grant.
